capabilities: Navigate documents via an outline panel that auto-expands on minimap hover and syncs with scrolling
Switch the outline between Title, Group, Dot, and Matrix views
Highlight vault-wide matches of selected text with pin icons and multi-color category markers
Run background vault-wide search with two-tier memory and disk caching and manual refresh
Configure hover triggers, highlight colors, pin icon appearance, and draggable minimap zone boundaries
disambiguation: Not a code-trace or debugging tool; it is a visual navigation and marking aid for reading long notes.
extras: Manual installation only: files must be downloaded from a GitHub Release and placed in the plugins folder. Formerly named SwiftMatch. README is bilingual (English/Chinese).
motivation: The author built it to provide visual positioning and knowledge marking for long-document reading.
problem: Obsidian has no minimap and its outline and search are not visually linked to the editor, making positioning in long documents slow.
summary: Long-document reading aid that adds minimap-hover outline navigation, vault-wide match highlighting with pin markers, and cached full-vault search.
